judgment: The small goes, the great comes.
image: So the ruler shapes the way of heaven and earth to its measure,
helps heaven and earth in what fits,
and so stands by the people.
lines: Pulling up couch grass by its roots,
Friends are lost — honour is won on the middle road.
No flat without a slope, no going without return.
Holding firm in hardship: no harm.
no warning needed, where trust is.
Di Yi gives his sister in marriage.
The city wall falls back into the moat.
Orders go out from your own town.

notes.name_en: 泰 is free passage between heaven and earth; 'Flowing', paired with 12 Blocked. Not Wilhelm's 'Peace'.
notes.L5: 帝乙 Di Yi, a Shang king; 歸妹 giving a sister/younger woman in marriage.
